performance.verdict: Paid channels fully dark; account runs on organic GBP alone, now collapsing.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google Ads both completely dark, generating $0 spend and 0 leads.
GBP actions collapsed 94.44% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 2–4) show 0 actions vs. 1–11/day in mid-August.
GA4 sessions spiked to 28 on Sep 1 then dropped back to 6–10, suggesting a one-off referral event, not a trend; 3-day avg (Sep 2–4) is 8.3 vs prior 3-day avg (Aug 30–Sep 1) of 14.3.
GHL pipeline is null and GA4 shows 0 conversions over 212 sessions — no intake path is capturing any of the organic traffic arriving at the site.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP recovery over next 3 days; if actions remain 0, escalate to client for Google Business audit.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have dropped 94.44% week-over-week and have been at 0 for the last 3 consecutive days (Sep 2–4). No paid channels are active to compensate. If GBP actions remain at 0 through Sep 8, flag to client for an immediate Google Business Profile audit (suspension, listing issue, or category change). Success check: at least 1 GBP action recorded by Sep 8.

suggestions.text: Fix conversion tracking in GA4: 212 sessions produced 0 conversions — intake path is broken or unmapped.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded 212 sessions and 172 users over the 28-day window with 0 conversions logged, and GHL pipeline is null. This means no lead is being captured or attributed anywhere in the funnel. Audit the GA4 goal/event setup and GHL intake form connection. Success check: at least one conversion event firing in GA4 within 5 business days, confirmed by Sep 12.
